title: Measuring the Rain

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: April showers! The rain is good for the garden, but how much falls? Let's find out.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: These rain jars catch the rain. Would you fill each one to its line, to show how much rain fell each day?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Fill each jar to its line. Hold the jug over a jar, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each jar to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Oops, that one's over the line. Tap it to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Now we can see it: which day had the most rain?

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: The middle jar has the most. That was the stormy day! The garden drank every drop.

journal_line: I measured the spring rain in jars with Miss Miriam.
